manifest.purpose: Golden submission: synthesizable Verilog module fifo_controller implementing a depth-4 width-8 synchronous FIFO with registered read output. Must match the public_spec.interface exactly (ports: clk, rst, write_data[7:0], write_en, read_en, read_data[7:0], full, empty). Internal state: 2-bit write pointer, 2-bit read pointer, 3-bit occupancy counter, 8x4 RAM array, registered read_data output. Full flag = (occupancy == 4), empty flag = (occupancy == 0). Write logic: on posedge clk, if rst then clear all state; else if write_en and not full then write data to RAM[write_ptr], increment write_ptr, increment occupancy. Read logic: on posedge clk, if rst then clear; else if read_en and not empty then increment read_ptr, decrement occupancy. read_data register: on posedge clk, if rst then 0; else if read_en and not empty then sample RAM[read_ptr] (the pre-increment pointer value for this cycle). Simultaneous read/write when neither full nor empty: both operations proceed, occupancy unchanged, read_data gets the old value at read_ptr before read_ptr increments. Overflow/underflow protection: writes ignored when full, reads ignored when empty, read_data holds previous value. Reset: synchronous active-high, clears pointers and occupancy, sets read_data to 0, empty=1, full=0 on next rising edge after rst release.
